description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, blinking Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it and Lonis trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
